tier_should.rationale: Novel empirical tests of population-ethics intuitions; multi-study design, clear manipulations of happiness vs suffering intensities; robust attention checks. MTurk convenience sample and abstract units limit external validity, but contribution to moral psychology is strong; fit with top cognitive science journals.

tier_will.rationale: Interdisciplinary topic with clear findings and strong execution suits top field outlets like Cognition. Authors’ profiles and multiple studies help. Nonrepresentative sampling and abstractness may deter general journals but should clear top field review.
